changelog:
- SMM Order Queuing: Integrated SMM task execution directly into the sequential device queues to prevent simultaneous execution conflicts.
- Account Creation Tasks: Safe sequential enqueuing for account creation. Restoring/login/creation tasks now cleanly queue and wait behind other active tasks.
- Timer & Event-Loop Bug Fixes: Replaced background QTimer singleShot calls with safe thread-sleeping and main-thread invocation to prevent silent task execution drops.
- Intelligent Order Deferral: The client now automatically defers cloud SMM orders as pending when no active devices are connected or capacity is busy.
